text:
Oliver: Hi team - I'm submitting my resignation today, last day proposed 2024-06-30. Can someone start offboarding? Need confirmation on benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, shipping laptop, and returning company YubiKey.
Maya (People Ops): Sorry to hear, Oliver. Quick answers: benefits end EOD 2024-06-30. COBRA packet mailed+emailed within 14 business days after that date; election window usually 60 days. First premium typically covers retro period.
Oliver: Thanks. If I elect COBRA, will coverage be backdated to 7/1?
Maya (People Ops): Yes, retroactive to the day after coverage ends (2024-07-01). We'll include carrier billing details in the packet.
IT-bot: Please confirm asset details for pre-paid label:
```
asset_tag: RDN-06666
device: MacBook Pro 13"
serial: SN-ZX12Q
```
Oliver: Confirmed. I'll ship it. Do I need to factory reset?
IT-bot: No need to factory reset. Leave device powered on and connected if possible; IT will perform a secure wipe after last day. We'll schedule wipe on 2024-07-01 morning.
Security: We'll run access audit 2024-07-01 09:00 PT and revoke SSO/org tokens after. Please remove any personal tokens from repos now.
Maya (People Ops): Exit interview - 30 min morning the week after last day? We can send Calendly. Final pay + PTO payout will be processed next payroll cycle; payroll notified. Asset return instructions + locker code or label DM coming now.
Oliver: Morning exit interview works. Thanks everyone for the quick responses.
Maya (People Ops): Sending DM with label options. If you need a visa/employment verification letter, tag me and Legal will draft. :handshake:
